chunks: As for what Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from al-Nakhaʿī, Abū al-Ḥusayn, who said: Ḥanān ibn Sadīr narrated to us, saying:
I made the visitation and then forgot the two rakʿahs of the tawaf. Then I came to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام while he was at Qarn al-Thaʿālib, so I asked him, and he said: Pray in your place.

key_terms.بِقَرْنِ الثَّعَالِبِ: at Qarn al-Thaʿālib, a known location
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الطَّوَافِ: the two units of prayer associated with tawaf
key_terms.صَلِّ فِي مَكَانِكَ: perform the prayer where you are

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget the two rakʿahs of tawaf until after leaving?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgot the two rakʿahs of tawaf until after departing. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructs that the person should perform the prayer wherever he is, indicating that it need not be repeated at the original location once he has left.
